title: The St. Andrews – Luxury Leather Passport Cover - Italian Vachetta
body_html:
The St. Andrews passport cover, handcrafted from premium Italian Virgilio Vachetta leather, elegantly protects your travel essentials while gracefully developing a unique patina with use. Its minimalist design and sophisticated details offer refined luxury for every journey.

  • Italian Virgilio Vachetta Leather
  • Handcrafted Quality
  • Secure Travel Storage
  • Elegant, Minimalist Style

The Story Behind the Name

We call it The St. Andrews, named for the iconic Swilcan Bridge that connects the first and eighteenth fairways of the Old Course. Originally built to guide livestock across the burn, it now marks a different kind of crossing: one made by legends, dreamers, and anyone who knows what it means to walk where history lives.

This passport cover is a nod to that journey. Thoughtful in design, timeless in character, and meant to travel far, just like the bridge that inspired it.

title: The Young Tom- Italian Leather Driver Headcover

The Classics Collection by Bluetross is a nod to the timeless designs that define the game. The Story Behind the Name

We call it The Young Tom, in honor of Tom Morris Jr., the game’s original phenom. At 17, he became the youngest major champion in golf history, a record that still stands. He was the first to win The Open four times, the first to record a hole-in-one in the championship, and the first name ever engraved on the Claret Jug.

This headcover is a nod to that legacy. Clean, classic, and built from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, it’s marked by just a single stripe and a number 1 — a quiet tribute to the player who got there first.

The Story Behind the Name

We call it The Devereux, after Devereux Emmet, one of American golf’s earliest architects and the designer behind more than 150 courses in the early 1900s. He brought a kind of graceful creativity to his work , blending natural flow with a willingness to try something new.

This headcover reflects that balance. A circle patch with a classic number cut-out, made from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, it’s simple on the surface but distinct by design. Just like Emmet’s best holes, it does exactly what it means to, and doesn’t ask for more attention than it earns.

title: The Mark aka "The Streaker" - Italian Leather Fairway Headcover
body_html:
The Classics Collection by Bluetross nods to the timeless designs that define the game. Crafted from premium full-grain leather, each golf headcover is built for durability, protection, and a refined look that only improves with time. Inspired by the visionaries behind the world’s greatest courses, this collection blends tradition with quality craftsmanship. Elevate your bag with a Bluetross Leather Fairway Headcover designed to last.

The Story Behind the Name

We call it The Mark  or as we like to say, “The Streaker.” No numbers, no stripes, no distractions. Just full-grain, vegetable-tanned leather in its rawest, most confident form.

title: The Devereux- Italian Leather Fairway Headcover
body_html:
The Classics Collection by Bluetross nods to the timeless designs that define the game. Crafted from premium full-grain leather, each golf headcover is built for durability, protection, and a refined look that only improves with time. Inspired by the visionaries behind the world’s greatest courses, this collection blends tradition with quality craftsmanship. Elevate your bag with a Bluetross Leather Fairway Headcover designed to last.

The Story Behind the Name

We call it The Devereux, after Devereux Emmet, one of American golf’s earliest architects and the designer behind more than 150 courses in the early 1900s. He brought a kind of graceful creativity to his work , blending natural flow with a willingness to try something new.

This headcover reflects that balance. A circle patch with a classic number cut-out, made from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, it’s simple on the surface but distinct by design. Just like Emmet’s best holes, it does exactly what it means to, and doesn’t ask for more attention than it earns.

Built for golfers who appreciate preparation as much as execution, The Trent brings together thoughtful design, practical function, and the enduring character of full-grain leather.

title: Custom Horween Leather Driver Headcover
body_html:
There’s a difference between a headcover that protects your club, and one that tells your story. Our custom leather driver headcovers are handcrafted from Horween’s Dublin leather, a premium full-grain hide known for its rich color, smooth surface, and natural pull-up effect that deepens with age. It’s not just a cover. It’s a keepsake.

At Bluetross, we believe custom should mean more than just putting your name on something. It’s about connection. Your initials, your logo, a nod to your home course or your favorite round. We design headcovers that feel personal because they are. Each one is made to order, tailored to your vision, and backed by our commitment to quality, creativity, and lasting craftsmanship.

This is luxury golf gear with a purpose and a personal touch.

How It Works:

  1. Choose your base leather color

  2. Upload design files or inspiration

  3. Describe your concept in the form below

  4. A designer will connect within 48 hours to confirm details and begin the design process

  5. Approve the design. We begin production

⚠️ Please note: All submitted logos or artwork must be owned by the customer or submitted with proper usage rights. Due to licensing restrictions, we cannot reproduce collegiate or professional sports logos.

title: The Cooper - Horween Leather Minimalist Card Wallet
body_html:
The Cooper minimalist card wallet is a slim leather wallet designed for carrying only what matters. Crafted from renowned Horween Dublin full-grain leather, it slips easily into a front pocket, tote, valuables pouch, or travel bag without adding unnecessary bulk. Known for its rich pull-up character and natural variation, Horween Dublin develops greater depth and personality over time, making each wallet uniquely its own.

Clean, useful, and intentionally understated, The Cooper brings Bluetross craftsmanship to an everyday carry piece made to be reached for daily.

• Sized at a compact: 4.38" W × 2.5" H
• All Hand Sewn Construction
• Card pockets on each interior side
• Optional discreet snap closure for added security

title: Custom Italian Leather Driver Headcover
body_html:
There’s a difference between a headcover that protects your club, and one that tells your story. Our custom leather driver headcovers are handcrafted from premium Italian full-grain leather, selected for its natural character, subtle pebble grain, and the way it softens and deepens with age. It’s not just a cover. It’s a keepsake.

At Bluetross, we believe custom should mean more than just putting your name on something. It’s about connection. Your initials, your logo, a nod to your home course or your favorite round. We design headcovers that feel personal because they are. Each one is made to order, tailored to your vision, and backed by our commitment to quality, creativity, and lasting craftsmanship.

This is luxury golf gear with a purpose and a personal touch.

How It Works:

  1. Choose your base leather color

  2. Upload design files or inspiration

  3. Describe your concept in the form below

  4. A designer will connect within 48 hours to confirm details and begin the design process

  5. Approve the design through our proofing system and we begin production

⚠️ Please note: All submitted logos or artwork must be owned by the customer or submitted with proper usage rights. Due to licensing restrictions, we cannot reproduce collegiate or professional sports logos.
